facts.fact: The Commonwealth Observer Group says the CNE has used biometric voter registration technology since 2008 and that 17,169,239 voters were registered for the 2024 elections.

The Commonwealth Observer Group says copies of the voter register are displayed where registration brigades operated so voters can scrutinise it and complain in writing, and that the final register was published on 4-9 July 2024.

systems.platform: biometric registration systems bought from a Artes Graficas and Laxton consortium
